static byte get_packheader_checksum(SPAN_S(const byte) buf, int blen) {
    assert(blen >= 4);
    assert(get_le32(buf) == UPX_MAGIC_LE32);
    buf += 4;
    blen -= 4;
    unsigned c = 0;
    while (blen-- > 0)
        c += *buf++;
    c %= 251;
    return (byte) c;
}
